items.name: Communication.AnyFunctionBlocksLongerThanExpected
items.text: Any API of mw::com (LoLa) blocks longer than expected (or indefinite)

items.name: Communication.InMemoryConfigurationWrong
items.text: The in-memory (cpp representation) does not match the on file-system JSON configuration.

items.name: Communication.FunctionCalledFromMultipleThreads
items.text: Any API is called within multiple threads concurrently without any further synchronization.

items.name: Communication.GeneratedCodeDoesNotMatchGenerationInputs
items.text: Proxys and Skeletons as data-types are generated using the aragen and not handwritten, may not match to the input (Meta-Model).

items.name: Communication.MisusedApis
items.text: APIs are invoked in either an invalid context or non public APIs are invoked.

items.name: Communication.CreationOfSkeletonNotPossible
items.text: It is not possible to create a skeleton instance

items.name: Communication.ServiceOfferedWithoutInitialFieldValue
items.text: A service is offered, although at least one of its field has no initial value set by the provider.

items.name: Communication.ServiceNotOffered
items.text: A skeleton service is offering a service, but the service is silently not offered. Note: offered in this case means, that it is also connectable

items.name: Communication.ServiceOfferedOnWrongBinding
items.text: A skeleton is offering a service on the wrong binding. Meaning, the service is not offered on the intended binding, but on an unintended one.

items.name: Communication.ServiceOfferedUnderWrongIds
items.text: A skeleton is offering a service with wrong identifiers. This can include a service id, a instance id or also the service version.

items.name: Communication.OffersAlreadyOfferedService
items.text: A skeleton offers a service that was already offered. Either by another process or by itself.

items.name: Communication.ServiceOnlyPartiallyOffered
items.text: A skeleton offers a service, which is not visible to all consumers, but only to parts of them.

items.name: Communication.StopOfferNotStoppedInSD
items.text: A service instance was offered via service discovery, but it wasn't withdrawn from service discovery in the stop offer.

items.name: Communication.StopOfferWrongInstanceStoppedInSD
items.text: Same as in StopOfferNotStoppedInSD. Additionally another service instance, which is still being offered, is withdrawn from service discovery.

items.name: Communication.StopOfferUnlinkWrongSHMObjects
items.text: Skeleton instance did unlink shared memory objects which do not belong to the service instance being stop offered.

items.name: Communication.StopOfferInconsistent
items.text: Skeleton instance is in an inconsistent state after stop offering: Either the stop offer was not forwarded to the binding or failed at the binding. Or it wasn't forwarded to the dependent service elements or their bindings or failed at them.

items.name: Communication.MemoryAllocatedInWrongSection
items.text: The memory for an event is allocated in the wrong memory section (e.g. in Heap, another Shared Memory segment or the stack).

items.name: Communication.TooFewMemoryAllocated
items.text: The event allocation allocates too few memory (including no memory at all).

items.name: Communication.WronglyAlignedMemoryAllocated
items.text: The memory for an event/field is allocated in a wrongly aligned manner.

items.name: Communication.TooMuchMemoryAllocated
items.text: There is too much memory allocated for one event/field

items.name: Communication.AllocatesAlreadyAllocatedMemory
items.text: The memory for an event/field is allocated from already allocated memory (not free memory).

items.name: Communication.SendingEventChangesUserData
items.text: A call to send manipulates the data that was provided by the caller.

items.name: Communication.SendingAnEventOrFieldSendsDataOnlyPartially
items.text: Data that is send by the user, only reaches partially the consumer. This can happen in two ways, only a partial number of consumers see the data or all consumers see only partial data.

items.name: Communication.SendingEventOnlyPartiallyNotifiesConsumer
items.text: When data is sent, consumers that have a callback registered, are only partially notified.

items.name: Communication.SendingEventSendsToWrongConsumer
items.text: An event or field is sent to the wrong consumer.

items.name: Communication.SendingAnEventOrFieldSendsSameSampleNtimes
items.text: Instead of sending a sample (one data point) only once, it is send multiple times.

items.name: Communication.SendingEventDoesNotFreeResources
items.text: Resources in the middleware that have been allocated with a previous allocation, are not freed after returning from send/update.

items.name: Communication.WrongResourcesFreed
items.text: A destruction of one skeleton instances, frees the resources of another skeleton instance.

items.name: Communication.NoResourcesFreed
items.text: The resources allocated on construction and during operation are not freed on destruction.

items.name: Communication.EarlyCleanUp
items.text: Resources are freed while still being used.

items.name: Communication.WrongMethodInArgsUsed
items.text: Unintended input arguments are used in a service method call. Therefore, the method call gets executed with wrong input data.

items.name: Communication.WrongMethodCalled
items.text: Either the wrong user provided method handler is called or no user handler is called at all. Therefore, the method call results are invalid/garbage.

items.name: Communication.WrongResultsProvided
items.text: The result of a method call is either not provided in the expected location, leaving uninitialized data in the expected location or it is provided in an inconsistent state. Therefore, the method call results are invalid/garbage.

items.name: Communication.StartFindServiceCallbackCalledUnexpectedly
items.text: The user-provided callback is invoked, even though it should not be invoked.

items.name: Communication.ServiceNotFound
items.text: A proxy does not find a service instance, even though it was offered by a skeleton.

items.name: Communication.WrongServiceFound
items.text: A proxy instance finds a wrong service. This could be either a wrong service instance or a completely wrong service.

items.name: Communication.ServiceIsFoundButDoesNotExist
items.text: Finding a service, returns a service, even though no service instance was offered.

items.name: Communication.StartedFindServiceIsNotStopped
items.text: A user called "StartFindService" with a given handler, and since "StopFindService" does not work, services can still be found.

items.name: Communication.WrongStartfindserviceIsStopped
items.text: The handle provided to StopFindService, is identified as another one and thus stops the wrong service discovery query.

items.name: Communication.SubscribeToWrongEvent
items.text: A service proxy subscribes to a wrong event. This either means that this event does not exist at all, is offered by another service instance, another event in the current instance or a completely different service.

items.name: Communication.SubscribeWithWrongMaxSampleCount
items.text: A proxy instance subscribes to an event to with a wrong sample count, meaning a different one that was provided by the user.

items.name: Communication.DoesNotSubscribe
items.text: A proxy does not subscribe to a skeleton. Thus, a skeleton does not know that a proxy is interested in data.

items.name: Communication.ReceiveHandlerNotInvoked
items.text: A proxy has set a receive handler and a skeleton is updating an event, but the receive handler is never invoked.

items.name: Communication.ReceiveHandlerInvokedWithWrongEvent
items.text: A receive handler registered for an event, gets called because of an update of an different event.

items.name: Communication.ReceiveHandlerInvokedMultipleTimes
items.text: A receive handler is invoked multiple times, even though only one event update happend.

items.name: Communication.ReceiveHandlerInvokedWithoutEventNotification
items.text: A receive handler is invoked, even though no event update happend.

items.name: Communication.CallbackNotInvokedDespiteSamplesAvailable
items.text: GetNewSamples() gets called on an event with a callback F, but the callback gets called not at all, although at least one new sample is available.

items.name: Communication.CallbackInvokedWithWrongData
items.text: A proxy receives a sample pointer via callback F(), but the data does not contain the expected one.

items.name: Communication.UsesToManySampleptr
items.text: User is already max. sample count SamplePtr, but we are still handing out SamplePtrs in callback F().

items.name: Communication.ReturnsWrongSampleCount
items.text: Value returned by GetNewSample() does not match with the number of calls to callback F().

items.name: Communication.SucceedsDespiteAnError
items.text: A user calls GetNewSamples() on a proxy instance and receives a sample count, even though he should have received an error.

items.name: Communication.ReturnsWrongFreeSampleCount
items.text: A user has already M SamplePtr in use from a max. announced number N, but GetFreeSampleCount() returns a different value than N-M.

items.name: Communication.DoesNotUnsubscribe
items.text: A proxy is subscribed to an event, tries to unsubscribe, but silently fails to unsubscribe.

items.name: Communication.UnsubscribesFromWrongEvent
items.text: A user unsubscribes from an event, but the unsubscribe is silently carried out on another event.

items.name: Communication.DoesNotImplicitRemoveReceiveHandler
items.text: A proxy has registered a receive handler and unsubscribes, this should lead to the case that a receive handler is no longer called. In this failure mode, the receive handler would still be called.

items.name: Communication.MapContainingNonexistentEvents
items.text: The map that is visible to the user, contains events that are not actually existing (e.g. in the configuration).

items.name: Communication.IncompleteMapOfEvents
items.text: The user gets presented not all events the generic proxy supports.

items.name: Communication.TheSizeReturnedIsBiggerThenTheActualValue
items.text: The user receives a size, that is bigger then the actual value.

items.name: Communication.TheSizeReturnedIsSmallerThenTheActualSize
items.text: The user receives a size, that is smaller then the actual value.

items.name: Communication.WrongIndicationIfFormatIsSerialized
items.text: A user, using HasSerializedFormat(), receives the wrong value.

items.name: Communication.MethodCallBlocksLongerThanExpected
items.text: A call to a service-method on the client/consumer side blocks longer than expected (or indefinite). This is a specific instance of FailureMode [AnyFunctionBlocksLongerThanExpected], but since with service-methods we have concrete root causes in the form of message-passing behaviour and behaviour of user-provided handler, we have this specific failure mode.

items.name: Communication.WrongMethodInArgsProvided
items.text: Unintended input arguments are provided to a service method call. Therefore, the method call gets executed with wrong input data.

items.name: Communication.WrongReturnValueUsed
items.text: Unintended results are provided from a service method call. Therefore, the caller of the method works on wrong data.

items.name: Communication.DoesNotFreeResourcesOnDestruction
items.text: A SampleAllocateePtr or SamplePtr is destroyed, which should lead to a freeing of resources, but caused by a fault they are not freed.

items.name: Communication.FreesWrongResources
items.text: A SampleAllocateePtr or SamplePtr free the wrong resources associated with them.

items.name: Communication.DoesNotReserveResources
items.text: A SamplePtr or SampleAllocateePtr do not increase their respective ref-counts and thus avoid data changes.

items.name: Communication.DoesNotUpdateFreeSampleCountCorrectly
items.text: When a SamplePtr gets created or destroyed for a given event instance, the Free Sample Count of this instance doesn't get updated accordingly

items.name: Communication.ReturnsWrongData
items.text: On dereferenciation of a SamplePtr or SampleAllocateePtr wrong data is returned.

items.name: Communication.MethodSignatureElementPtrWrongTarget
items.text: On de-referencing of a MethodSignatureElementPtr wrong data is returned.

items.name: Communication.MethodSignatureElementPtrFailsToFree
items.text: On destruction of a MethodSignatureElementPtr wrong memory is freed or not freed at all.
